빵.x: I have bread and milk in the morning.
빵.e: From Portuguese 'pão' via Japanese 'pan' — not from English.

색깔.x: These clothes are a pretty color.
색깔.t: 색깔 and 색 mean the same; 색깔 is more casual and stands alone, while 색 forms compounds like 빨간색.

착하다.t: 착하다 describes someone's good character; 친절하다 describes kind behavior toward others. Pronounced [차카다].

같다.x: My friend and I are the same age.
같다.t: Pronounced [갇따]; 같아요 [가타요]. The adverb 같이 'together' is pronounced [가치].

악기.ex: 어릴 때부터 악기를 하나 배우고 싶었어요.
악기.x: Ever since I was little, I've wanted to learn an instrument.
악기.t: Pronounced [악끼] — ㄱ after ㄱ becomes tense.

경치.ex: 산 위에서 보는 경치가 정말 아름다웠어요.
경치.x: The view from the top of the mountain was really beautiful.
경치.t: 경치가 좋다 'the view is nice' is the most common way to praise scenery.

초대장.x: I made a pretty invitation for the birthday party.
초대장.t: A wedding invitation has its own word: 청첩장.

평화.ex: 세계 평화를 위해 많은 사람들이 노력하고 있어요.
평화.x: Many people are working hard for world peace.

확대.x: The government announced a policy to expand jobs.
확대.t: Its opposite is 축소 (reduction); on phones, 확대 also means zooming in.

통신.ex: 산속에서는 휴대폰 통신이 잘 안 돼요.
통신.x: Cell phone reception is poor in the mountains.
통신.t: 통신사 is your mobile carrier, and 통신비 is your phone bill.

홍보하다.x: We're promoting the new store on social media.

고춧가루.x: I added a little more chili powder to the kimchi stew.
고춧가루.e: 고추 'chili pepper' + 가루 'powder', joined with ㅅ.
고춧가루.t: Pronounced [고추까루] or [고춛까루]. It's the key ingredient that makes kimchi red.

증세.ex: 감기 증세가 있으면 집에서 푹 쉬세요.
증세.x: If you have cold symptoms, get plenty of rest at home.
증세.t: 증상 is a specific symptom; 증세 is the overall state of an illness, but they often overlap.

작사가.ex: 그 작사가는 아이돌 노래 가사를 많이 썼어요.
작사가.x: That lyricist wrote the lyrics for many idol songs.

핵.ex: 핵 문제는 여러 나라가 함께 해결해야 해요.
핵.x: Nuclear issues have to be solved by many countries together.
핵.e: Basic meaning 'core'; it became the word for 'nuclear'.

사교성.ex: 사교성이 좋은 사람은 어디서나 친구를 쉽게 만들어요.
사교성.x: People with good social skills make friends easily anywhere.
사교성.e: -성 = a quality or trait: 사교성, 융통성, 적극성.

영혼.x: That song moved me to my soul.

독립운동가.x: Ahn Jung-geun is an independence activist whom many people respect.
독립운동가.e: -가 = a person devoted to a field: 독립운동가, 예술가, 작가.

복선.ex: 첫 장면에 결말에 대한 복선이 숨어 있었어요.
복선.x: Foreshadowing of the ending was hidden in the first scene.
복선.e: Literally 'hidden line', laid down early in a story.
복선.t: 복선을 깔다 means to lay foreshadowing.

막무가내로.m: stubbornly, obstinately, no matter what anyone says
막무가내로.ex: 아이가 막무가내로 장난감을 사 달라고 졸랐어요.
막무가내로.x: The child stubbornly begged me to buy him a toy.
막무가내로.e: Literally 'nothing can be done about it': impossible to reason with.
막무가내로.t: Pronounced [망무가내로]: ㄱ before ㅁ becomes ㅇ (nasalization).

과대광고.x: Be careful not to be fooled by exaggerated ads for health foods.

종교관.ex: 두 사람은 종교관이 달라서 자주 토론해요.
종교관.x: The two of them have different religious views, so they often debate.

학설.ex: 이 문제에 대해서는 여러 가지 학설이 있습니다.
학설.x: There are several theories on this issue.

유리 천장.ex: 그녀는 유리 천장을 깨고 회사의 첫 여성 사장이 되었어요.
유리 천장.x: She broke the glass ceiling and became the company's first female president.
유리 천장.e: A direct translation of English 'glass ceiling.'
유리 천장.t: The usual verb is 깨다: 유리 천장을 깨다, 'to break the glass ceiling.'

깨가 쏟아지다.forms: 깨가 쏟아져요 · 깨가 쏟아지는 신혼 생활
깨가 쏟아지다.m: (of a couple) to be blissfully happy together, to be lovey-dovey (lit. sesame seeds pour out)
깨가 쏟아지다.ex: 결혼한 지 한 달 된 언니 부부는 요즘 깨가 쏟아져요.
깨가 쏟아지다.x: My sister and her husband, married a month ago, are blissfully happy these days.
깨가 쏟아지다.e: When ripe sesame plants are shaken, the tiny seeds pour out in abundance, like the many small joys of a happy couple; sesame also suggests 고소하다 'nutty, delightful'.
깨가 쏟아지다.t: Mainly for newlyweds or new couples, often teasingly: 깨가 쏟아지네! A similar phrase is 깨 볶는 냄새가 나다.

과시욕.m: urge to show off, desire to flaunt
과시욕.ex: 비싼 차를 산 건 과시욕 때문이었어요.
과시욕.x: Buying the expensive car was just about wanting to show off.

상민.ex: 상민은 주로 농사를 지으며 세금을 냈어요.
상민.x: Commoners mostly farmed and paid taxes.

상주.ex: 장례식장에 가서 상주에게 위로의 말을 전했어요.
상주.x: I went to the funeral hall and offered words of comfort to the chief mourner.
상주.e: Literally 'mourning host' — usually the eldest son of the deceased.
상주.t: 상주 also has a homonym meaning 'stationed, resident,' as in 상주 인원; context makes it clear.

언론중재.m: press arbitration, mediation of media disputes
언론중재.ex: 보도로 피해를 입은 사람은 언론중재를 신청할 수 있습니다.
언론중재.x: People harmed by news reports can apply for press arbitration.
언론중재.e: 중재 is literally 'standing in the middle to judge'.
언론중재.t: Korea has an official body for this, the 언론중재위원회 (Press Arbitration Commission).

허구성.x: The reporter exposed the falseness of the rumor.
허구성.e: Literally 'the quality of being built from nothing'.

청산유수.m: speaking fluently and eloquently, a smooth talker
청산유수.ex: 그는 처음 보는 사람 앞에서도 말을 청산유수처럼 잘해요.
청산유수.x: Even in front of strangers, he talks as smoothly as a flowing stream.
청산유수.e: Literally 'water flowing past green mountains' — speech that never snags.
청산유수.t: Usually 말이 청산유수다 or 청산유수처럼; can hint at a glib talker.
